title: Death Smiles on a Murderer
writer: Joe D'Amato, Romano Scandariato, Claudio Bernabei
actors: Ewa Aulin, Klaus Kinski, Angela Bo
plot: Greta, a mysterious woman with amnesia, is taken in by the wealthy Mr. and Mrs. von Ravensbruck. The three soon enter into a love triangle that turns deadly, as Greta's gruesome past is slowly revealed.
